text: I usually wake up at six-thirty, even on weekends. My morning starts with a glass of water and a short stretching routine. After a quick shower and a light breakfast, I’m ready for work by eight. My workday is fairly steady: I sit at my desk, answer emails, join video calls, and take short breaks every couple of hours. At lunch, I often go for a brisk walk to clear my head. Evenings are dedicated to exercise—sometimes a gym session, other times a jog in the park. I eat dinner around seven, then spend an hour reading or watching a documentary. By ten-thirty, I’m in bed. This routine keeps me productive and balanced.
